title: 第19章 解惑第20章 指点
slug: 从部落开始我有一本山海经
content_zh:
次日，秦皓便与秦邬童二人进去恶魔林，向着更深的地方前进。
大黄想跟着秦邬童一同进来却被他拦下，毕竟这个地方越往内部走危险便会多一分。
当二人迈过平时狩猎的区域时，秦皓微微皱眉，他感觉到自己的鹰眼视觉比起平时范围已降低了很多。
无论如何都无法将范围延伸出去。
秦邬童见状不由询问着，秦皓便将情况告知。
“没事阿皓，禁区嘛，发生什么事都不奇怪。”
秦邬童抠着鼻子道。
秦皓有点不安，这段时日早已习惯了鹰眼视觉带来的便捷，如今随着深入，现在鹰眼视觉范围只剩下了二十米左右，而且秦皓觉得自己越来越吃力，不到一小会精神力就已经消耗大半，最后只能退出鹰眼视觉。
没有了鹰眼视觉辅助，二人前进的速度大大降低。
随着逐渐深入，秦皓发现周围的景象也渐渐脱离了他的认知，土地开始变得厚重紧实，周围的树木也变得茂密粗壮，到最后已经看不见上方的天空，阴暗潮湿的环境下总有着一让人毛骨悚然的感觉。
“还是不行，我的鹰眼视觉范围只能探测周围两米的位置了，邬童一切小心。”
秦皓再一次尝试下终于接受了能力的消失。
秦邬童点点头，此时也是无比紧张，二人以箭头的阵型向前迈进。
突然就听到一声细微的“嘶嘶”
怪响，二人才发现斜后方不知何时竟出现了一条头生独角的巨蟒正盯着他们。
辛级的犀角吐月蟒！
秦皓连忙给秦邬童打了个手势，告知危险准备撤离。
随后眼角又瞥见了木桩背后有一人影露着双血红眼眸正看着秦皓，吓得秦皓一时之间寒毛耸立。
定神一看原来不远处树桩后，是一只浑身漆黑的猿类血兽，此时正张着大嘴嘿嘿的笑。
秦邬童也发现了此猿，被吓了一跳，怒道：“阿皓，你对付这蟒，我去干了傻笑那货！”

说罢便冲了过去。
“诶！”
还没叫住就见到秦邬童已经冲上前去，一拳向黑猿挥去。
秦皓盯着犀角吐月蟒，心下暗骂邬童，鹰眼视觉莫名的禁用让秦皓逐渐烦躁，早已没有了往日的冷静，内心不知为何一股无名之火涌上心头，血纹显现，感觉力量气血大大增幅，率先发起了攻击。
秦皓一掌朝着头部拍去，犀角吐月蟒微微一闪，瞬间以极快的速度用独角狠狠的刺向秦皓的左腰，空中划出一道黑色的弧线，哪怕秦皓及时反应，但左腰还是被独角刮中，鲜血瞬间流了出来。
疼痛感让秦皓恢复了些理智，眼角闪过一抹凶狠，一个跟头翻越到巨蟒身后，打蟒打七寸，虽然不确定这蟒的心脏是否就在七寸之处，但是秦皓也没时间多想，右手握拳，气血凝聚，一拳砸向犀角吐月蟒的七寸之处。
察觉危险的犀角吐月蟒身体一扭再次躲过攻击，蟒尾高高竖起，瞬间将秦皓捆住，顿时一股巨力传来，秦皓两眼一黑，险些晕去。
不行，再过短短几秒自己将会被活活勒死！
想到这里秦皓开启鹰眼视觉，聚集气血，浑身突然开始猛烈的振动。
“寂灭环纹功。”
肉眼不可见的振动从秦皓身上传来，一段段声波攻击着蟒尾，犀角吐月蟒只感觉捆住这个人类的蟒尾一麻，随后激烈的疼痛不得不松开蟒尾。
秦皓落在地面，刚刚的贴身接触已经让秦皓找到了犀角吐月蟒的心脏以及频率，见此时这蟒还在因为疼痛翻滚，正是时机，躬身几个大步便冲向前，双掌血光浮动，竟发出嗡嗡声响。
感到危险的犀角吐月蟒不顾蟒尾疼痛，转头朝着这个讨厌的人类袭来，张开巨嘴咬向秦皓，要将其一口吞下。
“寂灭环纹功！”
双掌拍下七寸之处，秦皓明显感觉到一股波纹从双掌传到蟒皮又传导向内部。
“噗嗤”
一声炸裂的声音从身体内传出，犀角吐月蟒身形一顿，蟒头停在了秦皓身边，口吐鲜血缓缓倒地。
秦皓跪坐在地，连续两次使用寂灭环纹功，尤其最后一击为了能将振动传导进犀角吐月蟒身体内部，几乎消耗了全部气血。
content_en:
The next day, Qin Hao and Qin Wutong entered the Demon Forest and headed deeper.
Dahuang wanted to follow Qin Wutong in but was stopped by him. After all, this place becomes more dangerous the further you go inside.
When the two of them walked past the usual hunting area, Qin Hao frowned slightly. He felt that the range of his eagle eye vision had been reduced much compared to usual.
There is no way to extend the range.
Qin Wutong couldn't help asking when he saw this, and Qin Hao informed him of the situation.
"It's okay, Hao. It's a restricted area. It's not surprising what happens."
Qin Wutong picked his nose and said.
Qin Hao was a little uneasy. During this time, he had long been accustomed to the convenience brought by Eagle Eye Vision. Now as he went deeper, the range of Eagle Eye Vision was only about 20 meters. Moreover, Qin Hao felt that he was getting more and more strenuous. In less than a short time, most of his mental energy had been consumed. In the end, he could only quit Eagle Eye Vision.
Without the aid of eagle eye vision, the speed of the two men's progress was greatly reduced.
As he went deeper, Qin Hao found that the surrounding scenery gradually escaped his understanding. The land began to become thick and compact, and the surrounding trees became dense and thick. In the end, the sky above could no longer be seen. There was always a creepy feeling in the dark and humid environment.
"It still doesn't work. My eagle eye vision range can only detect the surrounding two meters. Wu Tong must be careful."
Qin Hao tried again and finally accepted the disappearance of his ability.
Qin Wutong nodded, and was extremely nervous at this time. The two of them moved forward in an arrow formation.
Suddenly I heard a small "hiss"
There was a strange noise, and the two of them discovered that a giant python with a single horn appeared diagonally behind them and was staring at them.
A Xin-level rhino-horned moon-spitting python!
Qin Hao quickly gave Qin Wutong a signal to inform him of the danger and prepare to evacuate.
Then from the corner of his eye, he caught a glimpse of a figure behind the wooden pile, looking at Qin Hao with blood-red eyes. Qin Hao was so frightened that his hair stood up for a moment.
After calming down, he saw that behind the tree stump not far away was a dark ape-like blood beast, which was grinning with its mouth wide open.
Qin Wutong also discovered the ape. He was frightened and said angrily: "Ah Hao, you deal with this python, and I'll go and kill that silly guy!"
After saying that, he rushed over.
"Hey!"
Before he could stop, he saw Qin Wutong rushing forward and punching Black Ape.
Qin Hao stared at the rhinoceros-horned moon-breathing python, cursing Wu Tong in his heart. The inexplicable disabling of eagle vision made Qin Hao gradually irritated. He no longer had the calmness of the past. For some reason, an unknown fire surged in his heart. Blood lines appeared. He felt that his strength, energy and blood had greatly increased, and he took the lead in launching an attack.
Qin Hao slapped his palm towards the head. The rhinoceros-horned moon-breathing python dodged slightly, and instantly stabbed Qin Hao's left waist with its horn at an extremely fast speed, drawing a black arc in the air. Even though Qin Hao responded in time, his left waist was still scratched by the horn, and blood flowed out instantly.
The pain brought Qin Hao back to his senses. A flash of ferocity flashed in the corner of his eyes. He somersaulted behind the giant python and hit the python seven inches. Although he was not sure whether the heart of the python was at the seven inches, Qin Hao didn't have time to think too much. He made a fist with his right hand, condensed his energy and blood, and punched the seven inches of the rhinoceros-horned moon-spitting python.
Sensing the danger, the rhinoceros-horned moon-breathing python twisted its body to avoid the attack again. The python's tail was raised high and tied up Qin Hao in an instant. Suddenly, a huge force came. Qin Hao's eyes went dark and he almost fainted.
No, I will be strangled to death in just a few seconds!
Thinking of this, Qin Hao turned on his eagle vision, gathered his energy and blood, and his whole body suddenly began to vibrate violently.
"The Ring of Nirvana Technique."
Vibrations invisible to the naked eye came from Qin Hao's body, and sections of sound waves attacked the python's tail. The rhinoceros-horned moon-votting python only felt a numbness in the python's tail that was binding the human being, and then was forced to let go of the python's tail due to intense pain.
Qin Hao landed on the ground. The close contact just now allowed Qin Hao to find the heart and frequency of the rhinoceros-horned moon-spitting python.Sui, seeing that the python was still writhing in pain, it was the right time. He took a few big steps and rushed forward. The blood on his palms floated and made a buzzing sound.
Feeling in danger, the rhinoceros-horned moon-breathing python ignored the pain in its tail and turned towards this annoying human. It opened its huge mouth and bit Qin Hao, trying to swallow him whole.
"Nirvana Ring Pattern Technique!"
Qin Hao clearly felt a ripple spread from his palms to the python's skin and then to the inside after taking the photo with his palms.
"Pfft"
A crackling sound came from the body, and the rhinoceros-horned moon python paused, its head stopped next to Qin Hao, and it slowly fell to the ground while vomiting blood.
Qin Hao knelt on the ground and used the Ring of Nirvana Technique twice in a row, especially the last blow, which consumed almost all his energy and blood in order to transmit the vibration into the body of the rhinoceros-horned moon-breathing python.
